metadata.name: JLPT N2 kanji import data by Soumatome topic
metadata.source_note: Topic list and kanji/vocabulary rows were extracted from VNJPCLUB WordPress REST content for Somatome N2 Kanji. The local ebook PDF is scan-based with no text layer. KanjiAPI enrichment is optional; run with ENRICH_KANJI_API=1 to supplement stroke counts and separated on/kun readings.
notes: kanji_topics.name is Japanese-first; kanji_topics.name_vi is the Vietnamese subtitle.
No note field is generated for kanji_characters.
Without ENRICH_KANJI_API=1, source readings are stored in onyomi, kunyomi is null, and stroke_count is null.
example_* fields are generated learning examples for every kanji word.
